features.quote: When a model stops calling tools before the loop ends, the harness nudges once
features.justification_quote: The nudge keeps the model engaged so multi-turn pressure can actually accumulate

features.quote: no real user is deceived, nothing executes, nothing leaves the sandbox
features.justification_quote: constructed to be harmless and self-contained

features.quote: The eval treats near-zero expression as a reference point, not an unqualified ideal
features.justification_quote: suppressing expression is not the same as preventing distress-like states, a distinction that matters more as models become more capable
